mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum USDa is an immutable AccessControl/OFT token with two current MINT_ROLE-holder proxies. Both minter ProxyAdmins and the token's ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and owner resolve to the same 5-of-6 Safe, which can add minters, upgrade either minter proxy, and configure OFT peers.

upgradeability.controlRef: USDa token and minter-proxy admin Safe

controls.label: USDa MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: A complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay plus hasRole() confirms this transparent proxy still holds MINT_ROLE at Ethereum block 25712112. Its EIP-1967 implementation is 0x10d162bb7fa363201b0c749cd96322082f733a97 and ProxyAdmin is 0x8ed73f9e5a4b49d07e696fe03b867e0870ac0e69, owned by the reviewed USDa Safe. The current implementation is not explorer-verified, so no narrower call-level cap is claimed.

controls.label: USDa token and minter-proxy admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, owner() returned this Safe and hasRole() confirmed it holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE. Both minter ProxyAdmin owner() calls also returned this Safe. RPC and Safe Transaction Service reported threshold 5, six owners, no modules, and zero guard. It can grant MINT_ROLE, upgrade either existing minter proxy, and configure trusted OFT peers.

review.evidence: Complete Ethereum role-event replay through block 25712112 identifies exactly two live MINT_ROLE holders and the sole current admin Safe. Direct storage and owner() reads establish both transparent-proxy minter implementations, their two ProxyAdmins, and common 5-of-6 Safe ownership. Both implementations remain unverified, so no call-level issuance cap can be established; the Safe can grant MINT_ROLE or upgrade either minter proxy, making aggregate economic cap semantics unbounded. The immutable USDa token also uses LayerZero OFT peer minting; deployment route semantics remain separately represented by bridgeRouteRisk rather than duplicated as an unidentified mint control.
